correction: docs/org-adrs.md recorded that snapshot.yml dispatches build to frostyard/snow (core ADR-0013). frostyard/snow had been renamed frostyard/snow-bootc, archived and marked Deprecated, and the continue-on-error 'Kickoff snow' step failed on every snapshot run checked (2026-08-19 to 2026-09-28) without failing the workflow. correction: AGENTS.md documented `make test` as running `go test ./...`, and the frostyard-go-repo skill documents `make bump` as running build/test/fmt/lint before tagging. `test` was missing from `.PHONY`, so make treated the target as the top-level `test/` directory, reported it up to date and ran nothing; `make bump` tagged v0.11.2 without running the tests. Every Makefile target is now declared `.PHONY`, and a test enforces it.
